name: Shilchar Technologies Limited
summary: Shilchar Technologies Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of transformers and parts in India and internationally. It provides power and distribution transformers, furnace transformers, linear transformers, telecom transformers, standard line transformers, R- core transformers, high frequency transformers, toroidal transformers, control transformers, HV choke, and inductors and chokes for solar and wind energy. The company also exports its products. In addition, it involves electric power generation, transmission and distribution.
